abstract: With the high development of computer technology and communication technology, computer system is facing a growing number of attacks.So, the security of computer system has become study focus in the world. This paper described the security architecture of the computer systems, mainly:ISO7498-2 security architecture and adaptive network security system model.Then, the requirements of the security technology were described by the information security and physical security.Finally, the core technologies of security system were studied in detail: encryption and firewall technology.

articleTitle: Research on Electrolyte Circulation Control System in Microfabrication
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the high-precision, high-efficiency and high-quality processing problems in the field of micro-machining, a new method of laser electrolysis combined machining was proposed. For the laser processing process easy to produce thermal effects and smooth electrolytic processing, the electrolyte circulation control system based on laser electrolysis combined processing was designed. The principle of the control system was analyzed, the hardware structure of the control system was built, and the software system was designed in detail. The system realized the automatic control of the electrolyte circulation control system through the opening and closing of each component

articleTitle: Robust Control of Gyroplane Based on Total Energy Control System and Backstepping Method
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Gyroplane has the advantages of simple structure and excellent overall performance and has extensive application value in military and civilian applications. The research objective of this dissertation is a small gyroplane, and its aircraft modeling and flight control law are studied. In order to improve the robustness of the gyroplane control, the backstepping method is used to design gyroplane attitude controller, and the total energy control method is used to design the gyroplane height and speed controller. We verified the backstep method and the total energy control method through simulation. The simulation results show that the backstepping method and the total energy control method have strong robustness. On this basis, the gyroplane verification platform is built, and the program of total energy controller is completed on the platform. Through the flight test, a large amount of flight data was collected and the actual control effects of the simulation model and the controller were verified.

articleTitle: The Key Technologies Research and Implementation of Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation Based on Real-Time Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper builds a typical HILS system based on the xPC real-time simulation platform and designs the key function modules of HILS by C++. A digital model of actual three-phase asynchronous motor speed control system is built and the parameters of the controller are optimized with the simplex algorithm. The optimized control parameters were applied to the HILS real-time control strategy model and downloaded to the HILS target machine. The A/D and D/A conversion was realized through the hardware I/O board, realizing the real-time simulation of the actual motor speed control system. By comparing the digital simulation results with the HIL real-time simulation data and curve images, the accuracy and effectiveness of the designed HILS system are verified.

articleTitle: Linear Motor Platform Contouring Control Based on NURBS Curve Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of high-precision machining of complex curves, NURBS curve interpolation and adaptive robust control (ARC) method based on task coordinate frame (TCF) are combined to study. Complex curve is designed by using NURBS curve interpolation. According to the geometric characteristics of the curve and the dynamic characteristics of the linear motor platform, the feed-rate is planned and the command path is generated. The dynamic model of two-dimensional linear motor is constructed, and then the dynamic model is transformed to TCF through the transformation matrix. At the time, the contouring controller is designed by ARC method. The proposed high-precision contouring control method based on NURBS interpolation is compared with the traditional cross-coupling control (CCC) method based on NURBS interpolation. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves satisfied contouring control performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multi-parameter Test System for Antenna Thermal Vacuum Test
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-parameter test system that can be used for antenna thermal vacuum test. The system consists of a one-dimensional rotating platform, signal acquisition, signal transmission and servo control system. The temperature and other signals in the test are carried out through the signal acquisition system. It is collected and transmitted to the master control system via a signal transmission system and connected to a remote computer via Ethernet. The hardware structure, communication protocol and software design of the antenna thermal vacuum test multi-parameter test system are given. Through the test in the vacuum heat environment, the results show that the system has high measurement accuracy and good stability, and can meet the requirements of the antenna thermal test under the condition of vacuum heat environment.

articleTitle: Correlation Method of English Vocabularies Learning on Internet Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In consideration of the particularity and the complexity of English vocabulary memory and the uncertainty of affecting factors, the paper proposed a correlation model of English words learning on Internet based on decision tree, aimed to solve the difficulties in learning English words. The model combined the vocabulary learning with the internet tools, resulting in a better effect of English words learning and providing English learners with a learning environment anytime and anywhere.

articleTitle: Analysis on Common Failure Mode of Circuit-Breakers for Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Circuit-breakers for electricity meter play a vital role in the normal operation of the terminal circuit and equipment of user. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to analyze and improve the common failure mode of the circuit breaker for electricity meter. This paper introduces several common failure modes of circuit breaker for electricity meter and analyzes the failure modes then adopts corresponding improvement measures, which effectively improves the reliability of the circuit breaker for electricity meter.

articleTitle: Inverse Computation with an SMT Solver
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An SMT solver is a verification tool that solves a satisfiability problem of first-order predicate logic with a theory using the theory's solver. Recently, many efficient implementations of SMT solvers were developed. SMT solvers were applied to various domains as back-ends of reasoning. In a usual setting, a program receives input data and returns output results. In inverse computation, if one gives output data to a program, corresponding input data is returned. This paper presents a use of an SMT solver for inverse computation. A translator of a simple imperative program was developed for a logical formula given to an SMT solver. However, since the computational complexity of inverse computation was expected to be very high, the possibility of inverse computation was studied using an SAT solver.

articleTitle: Intelligent Window System for Obtaining Weather Information Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A smart electric push-pull window composed of an actuator, a control system, a data acquisition system, a data processing system, a weather website, and a window. The system can collect real-time weather information such as temperature, relative humidity, PM2.5, wind speed, and cloudy or cloudy weather on the Internet through a data acquisition system. Then the data processing system intelligently decides to open the window to a certain width, and the control system and the actuator control the opening of the window to a predetermined width. The intelligent window can intelligently adjust the opening of the window according to the change of the weather, so as to improve the indoor temperature and humidity, and improve the indoor air quality and light. This intelligent window system has great application value.

articleTitle: Research and Development of the IoT Intelligent Operation System in Concrete Products
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the management, economy and transportation confusion and waste caused by incomplete communication facilities and low information exchange rate in concrete transportation, the research and design of concrete transportation based on Internet of Things (IoT) system was proposed. The on-board weighing detection technology and the key technology of the truck terminal are realized. And the system can realized real-time monitoring of operation status, truck intelligent identification, optimized driving path, on-board automatic weighing, delivery scheduling and management services. The system significantly improves operational efficiency and reduces production cost.

articleTitle: Thermal Stability Analysis of Metering Box Based on Temperature Rise Test of Interference Connector
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The electric energy metering box has entered into thousands of customers with the development of power electronic technology. Unfortunately, the quality problem of metering box components is more and more serious. Aiming at this problem, the thermal stability of metering box based on thickness of thermo bimetals are researched, which adopts the traditional circuit breaker of different manufactures. Based on metering box, the temperature rise test of interference connector is studied by using the designed thin hot bimetal strip [1-3]. Compared the experimental data of the designed thin thermo bimetals with the traditional circuit breaker, the result shows that the thickness of bimetal strip has important influence on the current carrying capacity and thermal stability, the research of this paper can provide technical basis for optimization of thermal stability about metering box.

articleTitle: Design of Step-Type Seed Metering Device for Sugarcane Based on PLC Control
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the problem of great labour intensity and low efficiency of artificial planting sugarcane and the existing sugarcane planter has the problems of the high rate of germination and uneven seeding, this paper designs an effective, reliable and adaptable step-type seed metering device for sugarcane based on PLC?Programmable Logic Controller?control. The seed metering device utilizes the super-control ability of the programmable controller to flexibly handle various processes flows in the seeding process, with high efficiency, low cost, uniform and reliable seeding, and it provides the reference for the design of sugarcane planting machinery.

articleTitle: Discrimination of Visible Impurity in Bottled Oral Liquid Based on Mixed Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: On the issues of the various kinds of foreign substances in bottled oral liquid, simplex method of decision and low speed on visible foreign matter, we presents a fast determination algorithm based on machine vision. The algorithm uses image graying and GAUSSIAN filtering to get the target to be detected by frame difference method. The images were then processed by Laplace sharpening and binarization, and the SURF algorithm is used to match the foreign matters in multi frames. Finally, the matching suspicious points are judged by weighted feature. The experiment shows, this algorithm can overcome the deficiency of single feature, it can detect all kinds of impurities accurately. Meanwhile, this algorithm deals with fast speed, it can meet the requirements of online production.

articleTitle: Path Planning System for the Aerial Work Robot with Self-Propelled
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Aerial Work Robot with Self-propelled is mainly used outdoors. The robot can replace high-altitude work platforms to a certain extent and perform maintenance and repair tasks for municipal projects and other routine projects. When the robot enters the operation area, it needs to walk and rise according to the established route, and prevent collision with surrounding objects in the course of operation and cause accidents. In this paper, the robot's driving path and work path are planned based on fuzzy logic control and reinforcement learning according to the operational requirements of robot. The reinforcement learning theory about anti-collision of robot is used to analyze the collision factors in the robot's driving process and the operation process. And then the robot can realize the ability of avoiding the risk factors automatically by the algorithms and achieves the safe walking and operation.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation of Radar Station Intelligence Based on Asymmetrical Closeness Degree
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the limits of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation on quality of radar station intelligence in actual training, a method of qual-ity comprehensive evaluation on radar station intelligence based on the theory of asymmetric closeness degree is presented in this paper. First, the evaluating metrics of quality evaluation on radar station intelligence are integrated and refined for six classes?i.e., timeliness, accuracy, availability, objectivity and continuity and so on, and then the corresponding assessing model is selected, for which the factor set?weight set, and comment set are established. Furthermore, compare analysis is used between the maximum membership degree, the Euclidean closeness degree and the asymmetric closeness degree method, to comprehensively evalu-ate the intelligence quality of the radar station. It shows that the asymmetric closeness degree method is more effective to take comprehensive evaluations of a certain quality of radar intelli-gence, and helpful for finding out the factors that determine the quality of the radar intelligence.

articleTitle: SRVDR Low-Side Active-Clamped Double-Inductor Current-Fed DC/DC Converter Double Closed-Loop Design
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to achieve low input current ripple and high voltage gain in DC energy-fed electronic loads, in this paper, a second-ary resonant voltage-doubler rectifier (SRVDR) low-side active clamped dual-inductor current-fed DC-DC converter is proposed. Compared with the active-clamped dual-inductor current-fed DC-DC converter, this converter has high voltage gain, low switching loss and high efficiency. First, this paper analyzes the conditions of the primary-side input current ripple and all the diodes are turned off with zero-current switching (ZCS). Then, according to the small-signal model of the SRVDR low-side ac-tive-clamped dual-inductor current-fed DC-DC converter to the designed the control system of the converter. Finally, a 200W prototype is built and tested and the results are provided, which has a very strong practical value.

articleTitle: Reverse Design and Rapid Prototyping of Single or Small Batch Teacup
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Single or small batch insulation cup was analyzed and improved based on reverse design and rapid prototyping technology. According to the structural characteristics of the selected insulation cup, the digital information of the model was accessed by hand-held laser scanner. Combined with the idea of reverse design, the sample space surface and entity model were reconstructed based on Imageware and Creo software. The sample entity model was reconstructed accurately by rapid prototyping technology. The comprehensive application of reverse design and rapid prototyping technology can improve the iterative efficiency of single or small batch cup, which has a good reference value for the development of single or small batch product.

articleTitle: OTHR Health Status Assessment Using Grey Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the fact that there is an inefficient fault in the sky wave over the horizon radar (OTHR) while it is not reported automatically?the health status assessment method for the radar based on grey clustering is proposed. In this paper, the assessment index system of OTHR is established. The weight of assessment index is determined by using the formula weight method?and the assessment model and assessment algorithm of health status of OTHR are studied. The results show that this method is simple and effective. It provides a better way to assess the health status of OTHR.

Author Keywords: sky wave over the horizon radar

articleTitle: Coherent Process for Random Frequency-Coded Chirp-Subpulse Stepped Frequency Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Random frequency-coded chirp-subpulse stepped frequency signals combine the advantages of frequency-coded signals and chirp signals. Positive characteristics of these signals include low probability of intercept (LPI), electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and anti-ratio frequency interference (APFI). Due to inter-pulse frequency hopping, non-coherent accumulation techniques have traditionally been used in signal processing which has led to the deterioration of target detection performance in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) as well as clutter environments and limited anti-interference. To combat this problem, a phase cancellation based coherent process for random frequency-coded chirp-subpulse stepped frequency signals is proposed. This method combines the Doppler coherent process and range synthesis in the condition of interpulse frequency hopping. The effectiveness is tested and verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: The Increasing Role of Online Peer-to-Peer Lending in Chinese Financial Market
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a representative of inclusive finance, online peer-to-peer (P2P) has become an important part of China's financial market and played a more and more important role. Since 2007, the development of P2P in China has gone through three periods: the non-regulatory period, semi-regulatory period and regulatory period. Based on the data from April 2013 to December 2017, this paper explores and compares the relationship between P2P and financial market during different periods. Results show that with the development of P2P, the correlation between P2P and traditional private lending has become stronger gradually. The interest rate of P2P is influenced by the supply and demand of financial market funds with the marketization characteristics.

articleTitle: Three-Dimension Model and Rapid Prototyping of Toy Pen Holder Based on Reverse Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Toy pen holder is analyzed and improved based on reverse engineering and rapid prototyping technology. According to the structural characteristics of the selected toy pen holder, a hand-held laser scanner is utilized to perform the digital information collection arrangement. Combined with the idea of reverse design, the reconstruction of toy pen holder's surface and three-dimension model has been completed based on Imageware and soildworks software. Finally, the prototype of the toy pen model is exported by rapid prototyping technology. The comprehensive application of reverse engineering and rapid prototyping technology can greatly shorten the product's development cycle and effectively improve the product's design efficiency.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Visualization Method of Editing Sub-Compartment Boundary in Forestry
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Combining 3D virtual scene rendering with forest sub-compartment boundary editing, a forest sub-compartment boundary editing method in the 3D virtual scene is proposed. First of all, the boundary nodes were calculated according to the sub-compartment vector boundary in the 2D, and the boundary nodes were represented by entities in the 3D scene. Secondly, the node entities that need to be edited were picked up by using the mouse, and then interactive editing operations could be done such as moving and building. Lastly, the sub-compartment boundary nodes sorting algorithms for the 3D visual editing such as moving, cutting and merging of the boundary were proposed. The sub-compartment 3D boundary was redrawn according to the order of reordering entities. Taking the 2D vector data and terrain data of the specific sub-compartment as an example, the 3D visualization method of editing the sub-compartment boundary in forestry was verified based on the MOGRE rendering engine. The results show that this method can restore the real 3D existence form of the sub-compartment, reflect its 3D spatial structure characteristics, and directly implement the interactive editing operations and simulation results of 3D visual moving, cutting and merging for any sub-compartment boundary. This method can be directly applied to forest resources investigation, planning to improve the management ability.

articleTitle: Ownership Concentration, Financing Structure and Enterprise Investment Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Ownership concentration is one of the influencing factors of enterprise investment efficiency. Higher ownership concentration is the main characteristic of the ownership structure of Listed Companies in China. There is a positive correlation between the ownership concentration and the inefficiency investment represented by the proportion of the first big shareholders, the proportion of the top five shareholders and the square sum of the top five shareholders. The structural index of ownership concentration represented by Z index has no significant correlation with the investment efficiency of enterprises. The positive correlation between ownership concentration and inefficient investment in state-owned enterprises is very significant. However, in private enterprises, although equity concentration is also positively related to inefficient investment, this relationship is not significant.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Constant Humidity Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a constant humidity control system based on PID algorithm is designed. The humidity signal is detected by capacitance sensor, connected to the MXT9030 for processing, and the capacitance value is converted to voltage value and sent to the MCU. The constant humidity control system adopts PID control algorithm, which has the characteristics of convenient implementation and stable control. The system is very suitable for modern families that require a comfortable environment and has wide application prospects.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Crew Examination Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The results of the practical examination of the Seafarers Competency Examination in China change from given by examiners to gotten from the intelligent examination in the simulation examination environment. In this new situation, it's necessary to develop a new intelligent crew examination platform to meet its needs. The system needs to balance both theoretical and practical examination, so as to ensure its fairness, efficiency and science. In this paper, based on MySQL database, developed by MFC (Microsoft Foundation Classes), the intelligent crew examination platform is integrated into the answer and evaluation terminal of the simulator, which is effectively applied.

articleTitle: Simulation on The Boundary Control of Steam Test Based on Jtopmeret
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Steam system is an important part of nuclear power plant. And test method is usually required to verify the system technical plan during the design stage. For effective simulation of steam export features at steam generator secondary side under dynamic conditions in a large-scale steam test project, two boundary control schemes of PID closed-loop and open loop were proposed. A simulation model of the test system was established using the two-phase modeling tool JTopmeret. In the early stage of the test, the simulation model was optimized and verified based on system thermal test data, and the accuracy and reliability of the simulation model were confirmed. Based on the revised simulation model, two boundary control schemes were compared. The open loop control scheme with better outcomes was confirmed as the control scheme of the final test. The simulation results provided effective guidance for the final test, as well as strong support for the successful accomplishment of the test.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Operation Tool Control System for Live Maintenance of Substation Equipment Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of a single function and a low degree of automation of live operating robot in the target substation, a multi-function operation tool control system for substation equipment charged maintenance and maintenance operation robot is designed. The system consists of three main parts: controller, sensor and actuator. In order to meet the control requirements of different operating tools, the system adopts different control platforms and different control strategies, and designed the human-computer interface. The system can enable the robot to perform multi-function operations, realize the automatic operation of the robot, and enable the operator to master the robot's state better.

articleTitle: A Multi-function Radio Frequency System Detection Efficiency Evaluation Method Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cooperative relationship between nodes in the detection efficiency evaluation for multi-function radio frequency system (MFRFS), an improved efficiency evaluation method based on entropy is proposed. Firstly, the information network process model is established when MFRFS performs the detection task, each node is established, the corresponding influencing factors and its membership function are selected. Then the uncertainty of each node under the cooperative relationship is calculated. And finally the detection efficiency evaluation for MFRFS is achieved combining the network complexity factor. The example calculation results show that the evaluation method is suitable for complex MFRFS.

articleTitle: Hearing Aid Speech Quality Evaluation Based on MARS
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Accurate and reasonable evaluation of hearing aid speech performance is especially important for hearing-impaired patients. In this paper, an objective evaluation algorithm for speech quality based on MARS (Multivariate adaptive regression spline) is proposed. In the algorithm, several basic features of speech signals are extracted, and MARS is used to select the key features that have great influence on speech quality. Then the optimal objective prediction model is built up to map the distortion measure of the characteristic parameter onto the subjective evaluation scores, which is substituted by PESQ. Finally, experimental verification shows that the correlation between the objective evaluation by the algorithm and the subjective evaluation scores is high, which is 0.978 and 0.9333 for training samples and test samples respectively.

articleTitle: A Local Integral Hash Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Nearest neighbor search algorithm plays a very important role in computer image algorithm. When the search data is large, we need to use fast search algorithm. The current fast retrieval algorithms are tree based algorithms. The efficiency of the tree algorithm decreases sharply with the increase of the data dimension. In this paper, a local integral hash nearest neighbor algorithm of the spatial space is proposed to construct the tree structure by changing the way of the node of the access tree. It is able to express data distribution characteristics. After experimental testing, this paper achieves more efficient performance in high dimensional data.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Static Characteristics of Sweet Sorghum Feeding into Shredder
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: From the Angle of mechanics of sweet sorghum forage harvester feeding chopped device's working principle and design requirements for comprehensive analysis, based on the optimization analysis of each parameter, the structure and working process of the mandatory feeding mechanism of the forage harvester were optimized. Parametric 3.0 software is used to design a 3d model of the cutting blade of the green fodder harvester. The maximum displacement of the dynamic blade was 0.123mm and the maximum stress was 93.6mpa. The research provides a reference for the overall research and development of forage sweet sorghum combine harvester.

articleTitle: Influence of Tide on the Horizontal Loss Rate of Cr in Jiaozhou Bay
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Taking chromium (Cr) in surface waters in Jiaozhou Bay in June 1982 as an example, this paper analyzed the horizontal loss processes of Cr, as well as the influence of tide on the horizontal loss. Results showed that the horizontal loss of Cr in coastal waters in the east of Jiaozhou Bay were calculated as 65.53×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> μg L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 6.50×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, or 65.53 YDFa and 6.50 YDFr, respectively. The horizontal loss of Cr in coastal waters in the north of Jiaozhou Bay were calculated as 55.03×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> μg L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 5.63×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, or 55.03 YDFa and 5.63 YDFr, respectively. When the tide was out, the direction was from the northeast of the bay to the bay mouth and was parallel to the loss direction of Cr, and the dilution of Cr contents was enhancing, resulting in rapid settlement of Cr from surface waters to bottom waters. When the tide is out, the direction was from the northeast of the bay to the bay mouth and was perpendicular to the loss direction of Cr, and the dilution of Cr contents was limited, resulting in little settlement of Cr from surface waters to bottom waters.

articleTitle: Study on Anti-rolling and Decoupling Performance of the Frameless Bogie of Medium-Speed Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the virtual prototyping technology, this paper analyzes the anti-rolling decoupling performance of a medium-speed maglev train bogies which has no frame girder and a mid-fixed traction linear motor. The simulation results show that the anti-rolling performance of the maglev bogies under suspended conditions is better than that under the landing condition; On the other hand, although its anti-rolling and decoupling functions are mutually constrained, it can be appropriately increased by the hinge stiffness of the anti-rolling transverse bar to improve anti-rolling performance. Therefore, the motor hanging stiffness and the anti-roll transverse bar stiffness should be reasonably selected to have better decoupling performance while satisfying the anti-rolling performance, thereby ensuring that the suspended vehicle runs safely and smoothly on the track.

articleTitle: Design of Hydraulic and Control System for Lifting and Lowering Manipulator of Core Drill Rig
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The lifting and lowering manipulator can greatly improve the lifting and lowering efficiency of core drilling rig. In this paper, the hydraulic and PLC control system is designed for the lifting and lowering manipulator combined with cylindrical coordinate and joint type. By analyzing the lifting and lowering drilling technology, the operating sequence of the lifting and lowering manipulator is determined, and the hydraulic system of the lifting and lowering manipulator is divided into five branches, which are respectively hand claw drive oil road, large arm expansion oil road, small arm expansion oil road, wrist rotary oil road and vertical column rotary oil road. The control system of the hydraulic drilling-off manipulator was designed, and the PLC program was completed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Simulation Training Platform for Performance Measurement of a Radar Antenna Sub-System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the parametric test ability of radar equipment support personnel, it is urgent to provide an effective training platform for the troops to carry out parametric test training. In this paper, the functional requirements of the simulation training platform are analyzed, according to the practical test requirements of radar equipment antenna subsystem. The overall design scheme of the simulation training platform is proposed, and the module circuit design of signal generation, program control attenuation, local oscillation, mixing, filtering are given. The practical application shows that this training platform can simulate the whole working mechanism of radar antenna subsystem and provide an effective training method for carrying out the testing of relevant performance parameters. It can solve the problems of equipment deficiency, equipment damage in the actual equipment training, and effectively improve training efficiency.

articleTitle: Flow Field Analysis and Model Machine Verification of Wing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the development and demand of long-haul UAV wing development, a bionic large aspect ratio wing is designed by studying the seagull glide attitude configuration. In order to further explore the flow field mechanism of the bionic wing, this paper analyzes the transient flow field of the wing based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method, and studies the influence of the feature of the seagull's convex wing on the flow field distribution and vorticity on the wing surface. The results show that the imitation seagull configuration wing produces a favorable vortex at the front bulge of the wing, which has enhanced airfoil adhesion and increases the stall angle of attack. The flow field variation of a large aspect ratio bionic wing with aeroelastic response is analyzed. The feasibility of the bionic wing was verified by designing a bionic aircraft model for flight test.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of University Information Management Platform Based on B/S Framework and APP
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: College information includes educational administration information, human resources information, teaching facilities information, teacher resources information and student information, etc. In order to improve the ability of management and integration of university information, an optimal design method of university information management platform is proposed based on B/S framework and APP. It adopts statistical analysis method to collect, statistics and classify the information in colleges and universities, and uses MySQL to construct university information management database. The network design of university information management platform is carried out under the system of B/S structure. The information management platform of university is divided into five management modules: administration, department, student, curriculum, backstage and so on. The design of network component interface of information management platform is constructed based on TinyOS. Native app local application program and Web app web page application program are used to develop the mixed information management system. So that the university information management platform can run compatible on APP mobile terminal equipment and PC terminal equipment, with Java as the development language, the design of information management platform is realized on the platform of J2EE enterprise framework SSH. The designed information management platform can realize the network of university information and remote information management, and the system has good stable performance and strong ability of cooperative management.

articleTitle: Abrasion Loss Prediction of Trapezoidal Thread Rod Based on Denoised Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There exists a direct wear influence of trapezoidal screw thread on its service life. It is necessary to determine the wear law to forecast the wear distance in order to design trapezoidal threaded rod. Therefore, the test bed is built to obtain a large amount of abrasion data at different speeds. And the wear data at 300 rpm is denoised by wavelet packet to smooth. And according to the data curvilinear trend, a variety of functions such as polynomial functions, power functions etc. are used to fit the data. Several fit goodness parameters show the best fitting function is a power function; and moreover, the fitting effect using the noised data is better than the original data by comparison. In addition, correlation analysis of data on both sides of the threaded rod proves that the two rods are of the high relevancy in wear. And during running-in preliminary stage, the difference between data from both side rods becomes gradually the biggest, but it tends to be stable since then.

articleTitle: A Method for Design Calculation of Two-Axis Magnet
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To further improve the similarity of a ship's magnetic field simulated using magnets, a two-axis magnet simulation scheme is proposed. The two-axis magnet is a new scheme with the same iron core, two windings, coaxial and orthogonal magnets. The shape of iron core, and the formation of solenoid winding and saddle-shaped winding are designed. The material of iron core, dimensional parameters, current flowing through windings, and number of turns are determined through calculation. The results show that the design of the two-axis magnet ensures that the volume and weight of the two-axis magnet do not exceed the standards, and its performance indicators meet or exceed the expectation. The design can provide a reference for the design and calculation of magnets with new structure.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Four Arithmetic Operations Learning Games in Primary Mathematics Based on cocos2d-js
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As one of the newest teaching resources, teaching games not only widen the field of curriculum resources, but also broaden the learning and teaching methods. It contains rich educational value, and plays an important role in arousing students' learning motivation, training creative thinking, forming research style of study and training information literacy. The article uses four arithmetic operations as the learning content, and uses cocos2d-X and JavaScript to complete a four arithmetic game, which is suitable for pupils to improve mathematics and arithmetic ability and to promote the logical thinking ability of primary school students. There are three levels of difficulty in the game: rookie, master and god. Students can choose different levels according to their arithmetic ability.

articleTitle: Research on Real Time Data Processing Algorithm for Optical Measurement
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The algorithm of optical measurement for real-time data processing based on Kalman filter is studied, by analyzing the present situation and exiting problem in the real-time data processing of optical measurement. In this paper, the feasible model and data processing method are given. The simulation results show that the algorithm model is accurate and effective. The research result plays an important role in raising the precision of real-time data processing. Meantime, it also has a guiding significance in further improving of measurement & control software system.

articleTitle: Construction of Brand Community Overlap Based on Ensemble Link Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Brand community marketing provides great convenience for companies to accurately target dispersed customers and audiences and carry out targeted marketing activities. The overlapping of friends in the brand community is important for cultivating members' interaction and improving the vitality of the entire network. The meaning. The Scoring Link Prediction Algorithm (SLPA) is the main method for constructing overlapping circle of friends, but traditional SLPA needs a lot of expert experience to select the appropriate algorithm according to the network characteristics, thus limiting its application effect in practice. This paper proposes a hierarchical cluster ensemble model which is based on knowledge granulation (HCEKG) to build a brand community overlap friend circle. The experimental results of 971 community networks in the twitter network show that the proposed HCEKG has more accurate and reliable prediction performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Vibration Control Device: Double Tuned Mass Dampers System with Inerters
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a mass amplifier, inerter can provide two orders of inertia force of its own physical mass. In this paper, a novel control device, the Double Tuned Mass Dampers Inerters (DTMDI), is proposed to attenuate undesirable oscillations of structures under the ground acceleration. By establishing the motion equation of the system, we can deduce the mean square of displacement response of the primary structure. To verify the superiority of the new system, the numerical analysis of DTMD and DTMDI are conducted on MATLAB software platform. The optimal DTMDI is evaluated and compared with the DTMD by normalized mean square and the dynamic magnification factor (DMF). Results demonstrate that the proposed DTMDI not only performs better than DTMD in attenuating structural vibration but can also endow with the superior stroke performance of the mass block.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics Analysis on Bearingless Motorized Spindle Rotor System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The bearingless motorized spindle is an ideal high speed spindle structure, which has the advantages of both magnetic levitation motorized spindle and bearingless motor. The dynamic characteristics of its rotor system which are the results of the combined effect of rotor structure performance and support properties of bearingless motor and magnetic bearing, affects the dynamic characteristics of the whole spindle system and even the machine tool. In this paper, the design process and dynamic characteristics of the bearingless motorized spindle are discussed. The modal analysis of the rotor system is carried out by ANSYS Workbench. The natural frequencies and vibration modes of the rotor under different stiffness are obtained. The influence of the support stiffness on the dynamic characteristics of the rotor is also studied. It provides a theoretical basis for the structure optimization and the control system design of the bearingless motorized spindle.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Space Heat Flow Simulation Software for Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the principle of spacecraft space heat flow simulation control system and its hardware and software structure are introduced. Then the algorithm and control mode of the software program used in the control system are analyzed simply. In the end, the optimization design of heat flow simulation software and its configuration file is expounded according to the complexity and diversity of control mode in vacuum thermal test, the different driving mode and communication interface of different program-controlled power supply. At present, the reliability of the optimized software has been verified in the thermal tests of the spacecraft components.

articleTitle: Application of High-Voltage Electrical Energy Meter in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Traditional metering methods are carried out on low-voltage side, and it can't achieve the overall traceability of metering equipment. The phenomenon of stealing energy at low-voltage side is serious. A method for measuring directly on high-voltage side is presented in this paper. Firstly, the working principle and characteristics of high-voltage electrical energy meter (high-voltage meter) are analyzed, and then a kind of testing device which can realize the whole traceability testing for high-voltage is developed. The device can be used to detect high-voltage meters with different sampling modes. The qualified high-voltage meter is used in the anti-stealing energy monitoring and early warning and line loss management. This paper combines the energy of high-voltage meters and the mathematical model of anti-stealing energy, and establishes the anti-theft early warning analysis platform. It has greatly promoted the development of anti-theft work and the lean management of energy metering. Also it has safeguarded the interests of both suppliers and consumers.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Automatic Detection Platform for Inner and Outer Rings of Bearings
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The paper introduces the research and design of a detection method of bearings inner and outer ring full-automatic detection platform. The full automatic detection platform mainly detects the parameters before the inner ring and outer ring of bearings are assembled. The detection system mainly adopts high-precision Solartron Metrology orbit series sensors and D300 high-precision air floatation turntable of Beijing aerospace Unite science and technology co., ltd. As the contact measurement mode of the tested parts rotation mode of rotational power, and with the help of transport robot, automatic code identification system and double-axis truss manipulator, the detection platform can realize full automatic detection.

articleTitle: A Fault Dictionary Method for the Diagnosis of Catastrophic Faults Using Power Supply Current
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Fault diagnosis of analog circuits is still more difficult than fault diagnosis of digital circuits. It is a bottleneck in the development of electronic circuits. Catastrophic faults are the major failures of analog circuits. Output voltage is traditionally used to diagnose analog circuits. A new signal, named dynamic power supply current is proposed for fault diagnosis of analog circuits in this paper. And an AC fault dictionary method is presented. Firstly, the dynamic power supply current of analog circuits is sampled under an ac input stimulus. Then eight fault features of power supply current are extracted. These fault features include four features in time-domain and four features in frequency-domain. Secondly, the ambiguity sets of every fault feature are built and every ambiguity set is assigned with an integer code. Thirdly, these fault features and potential faults are used to construct the integer-coded fault dictionary. The elements of fault dictionary are the integer codes. This fault dictionary can be used to diagnose the circuits-under-test. As an example, the proposed method was used for fault diagnosis of a band-pass filter. We diagnosed this filter using the dynamic power supply current and the traditional output voltage, respectively. The diagnosis results of two kind of signals were compared. The comparing results indicate that the dynamic power supply current is suitable for fault diagnosis of analog circuits.

articleTitle: Project for "Part Drawing" Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Project and independent study become two significant teaching methods under the new mechanical drawing teaching. This paper introduces the purpose, practice plan and implementations of part drawing project under the new teaching model. Since it is important to give equal value between knowledge mastery and skill development, between improving problem-solving ability and comprehensive quality in teaching, the part drawing project offers students the opportunity to meet and solve the problems, thus enhancing the comprehensive quality of students and achieving the curriculum objectives. The practice has proved that this method is effective to inspire the initiative, develop project consciousness and team-work spirit of students, which has attained great teaching results.

articleTitle: Research on Target Tracking System Based on SSUKF
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low target tracking accuracy of Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), a cooperative scheduling and tracking strategy for nodes is proposed. Firstly, the moving target is used as the stimulus, and the radiation radius of the sensor is used to dynamically set up the cluster network. Secondly, the detection node around the active target uses the simplex spherical Kalman filter (SSUKF) to estimate the motion state of the tracking target, and uses the target state estimation error. The covariance traces measure the tracking accuracy. From a comprehensive consideration of the hardware resources of the sensor network, the remaining energy and tracking error of the cluster member nodes are used as evaluation criteria to establish a cluster-first rotation strategy for dynamic clusters. Finally, the tracking tasks are performed in collaboration between the cluster members, effectively improve the target tracking accuracy. The target tracking process was implemented by using this collaborative scheduling strategy simulation, and the effectiveness and reliability of the tracking strategy were verified.

articleTitle: Design of Position Balance Controller for the Sprayer Boom
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to make the sprayer boom follow the ground undulation during the processing of work, we designed a controller based on electro-hydraulic servo system to keep the boom balance. As for the time variant of the parameters and highly nonlinear in the electro-hydraulic servo system, the fuzzy-PID control method has been designed. The position output can be controlled on a predicted track to fulfilled the standard of fast and accuracy via fuzzy-PID method. The establishment of the fuzzy-PID control system?realized the control of the nonlinear uncertain parameters in the electro-hydraulic servo system. After the simulation and verification, we compared with the traditional fuzzy logic method. The results indicated that the controller designed in the paper has a great ability to track and also has a favourable control results to the uncertain and external disturb of the system.

articleTitle: Research on OFDM Satellite Channel Estimation Algorithm Based on Training Sequence
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Large-scale global coverage is an important application scenario in 5G communication. Global information interconnection of satellite mobile communication is realized regardless of regional restriction. It is necessary to use modulation system of higher frequency efficiency to realize high-throughput communication. The system data throughout can be increased through application of OFDM. Due to the high PAR (peak-to-average ratio) of OFDM, high power return is generated. Meanwhile, Doppler effect results into intersymbol interference of OFDM. OFDM satellite communication channel estimation algorithm based on training queue is proposed based on foregoing problems. Firstly, the basic theory of OFDM and satellite communication is introduced to provide basis for further analyzing the adaptability of OFDM to the satellite communication system. OFDM modulation based on satellite communication system is designed including serial-to-parallel conversion and, coding mapping, inverse fourier transform, parallel conversion and up-conversion of satellite communication OFDM. The design of training queue of satellite OFDM is optimized to realize correlation peak detection, mark space and frequency deviation estimation and improve the channel estimation performance of satellite OFDM.

articleTitle: Linear Discriminant Analysis-Based Random Features for Kernel Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Random features, such as randomized Fourier feature maps, are often considered for accelerating the training and testing speed of original kernel methods especially on large datasets. The random feature maps are typically constructed based on the Monte Carlo or Quasi-Monte Carlo methods for approximating the integral representations of shift-invariant kernels. However, such universally random (or quasi-random) method for generating the parameters of feature maps cannot guarantee the optimal performance due to the lack of biases for the specific problems we are handling with. Hence this paper proposes a new random feature map construction method based on linear discriminant analysis, which is problem-dependent and hence improve the performance of random features for modeling. Simulation results show that the proposed method can remarkably enhance the original random features both in model complexity and generalization performance.

articleTitle: A Signal Enhancement Algorithm by SNR Maximization of Specified Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A signal enhancement algorithm for SNR maximization of specified frequency range is proposed in this paper to improve the signal enhancement performance, which uses a priori knowledge of the covariance matrix of noise in the mixed signal, enhances the required signal and maximizes the SNR of specified frequency range by linear combination of multi-channel received signals. The algorithm in this paper is derived and simulated compared with the signal enhancement algorithm of time domain, the result shows that the enhanced signal has maximal SNR of specified frequency range, and the algorithm has a obviously better performance and application value.

articleTitle: Stable Hierarchical Clustering Analysis Based on New Designed Cluster Validity Index
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Cluster validity index (CVI) is an important method for evaluating the effect of clustering results generated by clustering algorithms. Currently, many CVIs have proposed, but they are suffering from issues of unstable and narrow range of applications. Therefore, a new clustering validity index-NCVI, is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the NCVI index combines the idea of maximum spanning tree and Euclidean distance formula. The clustering results are obtained by using the average of the sum of the weights of the maximum spanning trees of each cluster and the minimum distance between the clusters using the Euclidean distance between each cluster center point. At the same time, based on the underlying algorithm (average link hierarchical clustering algorithm) to determine the optimal cluster number, combined with the new cluster validity index NCVI designed a new K value optimization algorithm (KVOA). Finally, the paper evaluates the validity of the newly proposed index (NCVI) through four simulation data sets and two UCI real data sets, and compares it with other six classical indicators. The experimental results show that the proposed index has a good performance advantage over other indexes in the tested data set.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Simulator for Lifting and Withdrawing a Certain Type of High-Powered Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to enhance the operational skills of the radar equipment operators in erecting the withdrawal equipment, it is imperative to provide a corresponding simulation training platform for the training of the troops. In this paper, according to the practical requirements of a certain type of high-powered radar erection and withdrawal training, the definition of the function of the simulator is given, the overall design scheme of the system is proposed, and the hardware and software design of each major function module is given. The practical application shows that the training simulator can realistically simulate the erection and withdrawal operation procedure of the radar equipment, and can feedback the correctness and error, and provide corresponding prompts. It provides an effective training means for the equipment erection and withdrawal, and can better solve practical teaching. There are many problems such as fewer people and more equipment and equipment damage, which effectively improves the efficiency of equipment teaching.

articleTitle: Research of Sentiment Analysis Based on Long-Sequence-Term-Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A method based on Long-Sequence-Term-Memory model and vector embedding to analyze sentiments of the online reviews is proposed in this paper. In order to obtain the vector representation from sentence level, it uses the extraction methods of LSTM, which is based on non-liner learning, to extend the vector embedding to sentence representation, and to achieve sentence embedding ultimately. The experimental results proved the high accuracy of this method, with which could live up to 91.35% when classifying the sentiments of online reviews. The ability to be applied to variety languages and the strong scalability of large scale corpus are two of its advantages, meanwhile, feature extraction of bigram can also improve its test accuracy. As the experimental results showed that the sentiment analysis method based on the LSTM model and the principle of embedding word is a highly effective method of sentiment analysis, and it has the strong scalability and can be applied to comments of different languages.

articleTitle: Method and Implementation of Server Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This article introduces a method of load balancing. This method can automatically and reasonably allocate information processing requests based on the real-time resources of the server without introducing additional devices in the cloud computing process. The technology establishes a cluster architecture without load balancing devices, including a task pool, a task publishing module, and a task acquisition module. This technology uses "pulling" to distribute tasks. This method can dynamically allocate computing resources in the cluster. This technology does not require registration nodes to join or exit, and nodes do not interact with each other. It is easy to adjust the cluster size. The use of this technology avoids the waste of system computing resources due to bottlenecks in key nodes, unreasonable task assignments, and the like. This technology reduces the cost of the cluster system, and at the same time solves the problem that the load balancing device can easily become the bottleneck of the cluster.

articleTitle: Smart Meter Lifecycle Management System Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of lifecycle management of massive smart meters, this paper designs a smart meter based on RFID communication, a meter detection system based on RFID smart meter, an intelligent warehouse management system based on RFID smart meter and cloud platform, a on-site meter reading RFID hand-held terminal based on RFID and cloud platform, using cloud platform and cloud computing technology and radio frequency identification technology. A smart meter lifecycle cloud platform management system based on cloud platform is proposed. The whole system utilizes high communication speed and strong group reading of RFID to achieve quick parameter setting, quick detection, automatic storage, quick reading of smart meters. It can shorten the time and improve efficiency. Meanwhile, the whole system can help intelligent production and service under Industry 4.0 mode by building a cloud platform management system to realize data collection, data management, data filtering and extraction, data mining and analysis of large amount of smart meters.

articleTitle: Research on Countermeasures to Reduce Logistics Cost
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The voices to reduce logistics costs are increasing, and reducing logistics costs has become the consensus of all walks of life.Through combing and analyzing the current situation of China's logistics cost, the reasons and harms of high logistics cost, and the path and countermeasures of reducing logistics costs, combining with the domestic research on reducing logistics costs, five countermeasures are proposed.

articleTitle: Teapot Three-Dimensional Geometrical Model Reconstruction Based on Reverse Engineering and Rapid Prototyping Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the 3D modeling method reconstruction of reverse engineering and rapid prototyping technology, the surface of the kettle body and the lid of the teapot was digitized, realizing the process of entity → 3D data → 3D model reconstruction → entity model. In this paper, the teapot surface was digitally measured with the non-contact digital technology, handheld 3D laser scanner to obtain a lot of point-cloud data. The reconstruction of the model was accomplished using computer-aided software such as Imageware and UG, and the output of entity modeling was achieved using a rapid prototyping machine. The combination of reverse engineering and rapid prototyping technology simplifies the process of product reoptimization and effectively shortens the design and the development cycle of the product.

articleTitle: An Approach for Detecting Spammer Invasion Events with Poisson Process
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The spammer, referring to the user who sends large amount of unrelated information to recipients without permission in a short period, brings a serious threat to social network security. Interestingly, we find that the change of network structure can be helpful for the identification of spammer invasion events. In the paper, a method which aggregates fifteen kinds of network structure indicators together is proposed to detect spammer invasion events in time series based on Poisson process. Tested on the dataset of Tagged.com, our proposed approach outperforms other state-of-the-art methods in precision, recall and F1-score. Also, the result validates that the key indicators for detecting spammer invasion events are comprised of ABC, SHC, MD. The method presented will be refined and extended to cases of detecting spammers dynamically.

articleTitle: A Variant of WSL Framework For Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Scene understanding is an important task in the field of machine vision. Image semantic segmentation is helpful to realizes scene understanding by identifying semantic information in images. Due to fully supervised semantic segmentation need a lot of manual annotation, but its costs is so expensive. So Weakly supervised Learning(WSL) become more and more popular. In this paper, we analyze this problem from a new perspective. We only use a small amount of data as a training set and solve the problem with only the image label. First, we only train the existing neural network to complete the weakly supervised semantic segmentation task; Second, we change classification network from a WSL framework to encourage neural networks to identify semantic information in images. We conducted experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, and our results have some improvement in semantic segmentation.

articleTitle: A Comparison between English and Chinese Commendatory and Derogatory Words?A Study Based on Dictionaries and Thesauri
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Commendatory and derogatory words are two kinds of words which have additional attitudinal inclination based on the conceptual meaning of the words. Utterers convey their positive or negative attitude towards people, objects, and phenomena in discourses with commendatory and derogatory words both intentionally and unconsciously. This study draws multifaceted comparisons between Chinese and English commendatory and derogatory words from the aspects of scale, distribution of POT (parts of speech), morpheme structure, meaning extension, and application in discourses through statistics and analyses of dictionaries and thesauri.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study of Electrolyte Jet-Assisted Laser Micromachining and Punching
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For traditional laser processing methods, processing defects such as recast layers, micro cracks, and high concentration of heat-affected zones are inevitably generated, which reduces the quality of the micro-structured surface and service life. This paper proposes an electrolyte assisted laser mic micro fabrication technique that uses a laser beam and a corrosive jet of electrolyte fluid Coaxial on the artifacts. The corrosive electrolyte jet continuously scours, cools and micro-etches the processing area while the laser is working. The effect can reduce the thickness of the recast layer, reduce the number of micro-cracks, and eliminate the high concentration of heat affected zone. In this paper, the mechanism of laser-assisted laser micro fabrication is studied; mathematical model of fluid field and temperature field in laser-assisted drilling of electrolyte jet is established; experiment of electrolyte-assisted laser drilling and analysis of result are carried out. Electrolyte-jet-assisted laser micro fabrication, the basic processing technology, lays the foundation for further research on the electrolyte assisted laser micro fabrication technology .

articleTitle: A Problem-Specific Constrained Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Multi-objective optimization problem is a kind of problem optimizing simultaneously several conflicting objectives and keeping a balance between the diversity and the convergence of solutions. In this paper, some novel techniques are designed to improve the efficiency of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms. Firstly, fitness in keeping with feasibility is designed to choose the individual with good feasibility as much as possible; secondly, a specific sub-function is separated from a series of objectives, which is applied to provide an approximate search direction and speed the convergence of the algorithm. Thirdly, differential evolution is used to make the population search to the optimal solutions; then, the crowding degree scheme, as in NSGA-II, is used to select potential promising solutions in the process of iterations such that Pareto front is uniform as much as possible. Finally, a novel multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is presented by embedding these schemes. The simulation illustrates the effectives of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Torque Converter Based on ANSYS Workbench
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: First, the single-phase flow path model of torque converter is established by using three-dimensional software, and the STP format file is derived.Then we should set up an analysis module in workbench.Second, we should import the flow model and divide grids.In order to guarantee the quality, we choose hexahedral grids.At the same time, the boundary condition is set.The velocity diagram of the whole flow passage of the torque converter and the inlet and outlet pressure diagram of each working wheel are obtained.Finally, the results are processed and analyzed, then compared with the experimental results, and the simulation design is realized.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition with Smartphone Inertial Sensors Using Bidir-LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Owing to its extensive applications in solving real-life, human-centric problems, human activity recognition (HAR) has become an important research area in pervasive computing. Most Human activity recognition researches are based on multi-sensor based approaches which use three or more sensors attached on the different parts of human body. However, many sensors were redundant for specific motions. The more sensors being used, the less convenience the users have. The current generation of portable mobile devices incorporates various types of sensors that open up new areas for the analysis of human behavior. Smartphone can be used for the activity recognition of rehabilitation, aged care and so on. In this paper, we propose a bidirectional LSTM structure for human activity recognition using time series, collected from a smartphone (with the accelerometer and gyroscope embedded on the phone) worn on the waist of human, the best recognition accuracy of which can reach 93.79%.

articleTitle: A Smart Manufacturing Compliance Architecture of Electronic Batch Recording System (eBRS) for Life Sciences Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The paradigm shift brought about by smart manufacturing or Industrie 4.0 has posed threefold challenges to electronic batch recording system (eBRS) in Life Sciences Industry: 1) the structure of the data should be informative and standard for interoperate using information models, 2) administration of synchronization between physical world and cyber world for smart decision making and optimization using cyber physical system (CPS) and 3) so-called digital manufacturing operations management (digital MOM) characterized by decentralization, comprehensive collaboration and servitization shall be implemented. Under the new situations of smart manufacturing or Industrie 4.0, the requirements from information models, CPS and digital MOM will become the most principal criteria to be considered for future eBRS/MES and other operations management information system in shop floor. To fulfill these demands, an approach combining ISA95/88 hybrid model with activities ontology and variant domain-driven design for SOA-based eBRS development has been presented. An eBRS software platform has been developed on the theoretical basis and applied to a specific application scenario of Lyophilized Injection Production for verifying its feasibility purpose.
